title: RoboArchitect: Automating the Design of Robotic Agents with Persistent Memory
title_zh: RoboArchitect：自动化设计具有持久记忆的机器人智能体

paragraphs.en: Recent work shows that a frozen robot policy performs far better inside an agent harness, where control code decides when to query the policy, consult vision tools, or command the arm directly. Yet today these harnesses are built by hand and redesigned for each new robot or benchmark. We show that harness design can be automated, offering a strong alternative to finetuning on a novel setup. In RoboArchitect , a coding model observes a robot’s rollouts, diagnoses failures, and iteratively revises the harness around the frozen policy. The harness evolves on a set of episodes for its optimization and is evaluated on held-out scenes and tasks. Without updating any model weights, RoboArchitect raises average success from 9.7% to 43.3% on unseen scenes (4.5 × \times ) and from 12.7% to 40.2% on unseen tasks (3.2 × \times ), across multiple benchmarks and policies. The gains are largest where the benchmark is far from the policy’s training data: wrapping a general-purpose policy, the evolved harness yields a specialist that often outperforms even the finetuned version. Intuitive control strategies are automatically designed, such as lifting a jammed arm clear or reaching in horizontally when an obstacle blocks the way from above. The harness also evolves its own persistent memory, carrying learned experience, such as effective grasp depths, into later decisions. These results suggest that substantial headroom in robotic manipulation lies in the agent harness, and its design can be effectively automated and optimized without weight updates.

paragraphs.en: Language models have become far more useful inside an agent harness: surrounding code that mediates when and how to call the model, what context to supply, and how to handle its output. Robot policies are undergoing the same shift. This shift is particularly important for robotics, where adapting a policy to new tasks or hardware often requires collecting new demonstrations and finetuning model weights ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Zang et al., 2025 ; Park et al., 2026 ) . We posit that harness optimization offers an effective alternative to finetuning, turning a general policy into a specialist for a specific robot setup ( Section 4.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型在智能体框架内的作用已大大增强：所谓框架，是指围绕模型的外围代码，用于决定何时以及如何调用模型、提供什么样的上下文，以及如何处理模型的输出。 机器人策略正在经历同样的转变。 这一转变对机器人领域尤为重要，因为要让策略适应新任务或新硬件，往往需要采集新的演示数据并对模型权重进行微调（Kim et al., 2024；Zang et al., 2025；Park et al., 2026）。 我们认为，框架优化为微调提供了一种有效的替代方案，能够将通用策略转化为针对特定机器人配置的专用策略（第 4.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: Recent agentic robot systems like VoLo ( Chen et al., 2026d ) and Harness VLA ( Zhang et al., 2026e ) show strong gains from wrapping frozen policies in hand-written harnesses ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026b ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) . Today, these harnesses are still manually designed, often requiring substantial engineering effort for each task and embodiment. Building such a harness follows a familiar trial-and-error loop: run the agent on the robot, observe where it fails, diagnose the cause, modify the control code, and test again. This work is slow to perform by hand, and long recordings of robot rollouts are difficult for a human engineer to inspect exhaustively. We ask whether this complete engineering loop, from diagnosing failure traces to refining the harness design to fix them, can be automated .
paragraphs.zh: 近期的智能体机器人系统，如 VoLo（Chen et al., 2026d）和 Harness VLA（Zhang et al., 2026e），表明将冻结策略封装在手写的工具框架中能带来显著提升（Xu et al., 2026；Zhao et al., 2026b；Gao et al., 2026；Hu et al., 2026）。 目前，这些工具框架仍是人工设计的，通常需要针对每个任务和机器人本体投入大量的工程工作。 构建这样的工具框架遵循一个熟悉的试错循环：在机器人上运行智能体，观察其失败之处，诊断原因，修改控制代码，然后再次测试。 这项工作通过手工执行十分缓慢，而且人工工程师难以详尽地检查机器人长时程的长篇记录。 我们提出这样一个问题：从诊断失败轨迹到改进工具框架设计以修复这些失败的完整工程循环，能否被自动化。

paragraphs.en: In this work, RoboArchitect uses a coding model to automatically design and optimize the harness ( Section 3 ). Given access to a frozen policy, auxiliary vision and language tools, and step-by-step rollout recordings, the coding model diagnoses failure modes and proposes an updated harness to address them. Like a finetuned policy, a harness optimized on specific rollouts could overfit to them. We therefore split each benchmark into “training” (for harness optimization) and held-out episodes, evaluating on unseen scenes , where tasks are shared but scene arrangements differ, and unseen tasks , where held-out episodes contain entirely different tasks that require shared manipulation skills ( Section 4.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，RoboArchitect 使用一个编码模型来自动设计和优化 harness（第 3 节）。 在可以访问一个冻结的策略、辅助视觉与语言工具以及逐步 rollout 记录的情况下，该编码模型诊断失败模式并提出更新后的 harness 来解决这些问题。 与微调后的策略一样，在特定 rollout 上优化得到的 harness 可能会对这些 rollout 过拟合。 因此，我们将每个基准拆分为「训练」集（用于 harness 优化）和保留集，并在未见场景和未见任务上进行评估：在未见场景中，任务相同但场景布局不同；在未见任务中，保留集包含完全不同的任务，这些任务需要共享的操作技能（第 4.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: Across diverse benchmarks and policies, our auto-optimized harnesses raise the average success rate on unseen scenes from 9.7% to 43.3% (4.5 × \times ), and on unseen tasks from 12.7% to 40.2% (3.2 × \times ) ( Fig. 1 ). The strongest gains occur when policies are deployed in out-of-domain settings, where RoboArchitect can effectively substitute for new training data: wrapping a general policy yields a specialist that often outperforms the finetuned version of the same model. For example, in settings where the vision-language-action (VLA) policy contributes no useful signal, the harness learns to stop querying it and instead drives the arm from its own perception, effectively becoming a code-as-policy agent. While code-as-policy ( Liang et al., 2023 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Elmaaroufi et al., 2026 ) and learned VLA policies ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Intelligence et al., 2025 ) have traditionally been treated as distinct paradigms, RoboArchitect unifies them empirically ( Section 4.2 ). Unlike weight updates, each harness revision is also fully interpretable: it targets specific failure modes with intuitive control logic ( Figs. 3 and 6 ), making subsequent revisions easy to inspect and build upon, and such iterative refinement proves to be key to generalization ( Section 4.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在多个多样化基准和策略上，我们的自动优化控制架构将未见场景的平均成功率从 9.7% 提升至 43.3%（4.5 × \times 倍），将未见任务的平均成功率从 12.7% 提升至 40.2%（3.2 × \times 倍）（图 1）。 当策略被部署在域外环境时，收益最为显著，此时 RoboArchitect 可以有效替代新的训练数据：将通用策略包装起来即可得到一个专业智能体，其性能往往优于同一模型的微调版本。 例如，在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略无法提供有效信号的环境中，控制架构学会停止查询该策略，转而依靠自身的感知来驱动机械臂，实际上成为一个 code-as-policy 智能体。 尽管 code-as-policy（Liang 等，2023；Lu 等，2026；Elmaaroufi 等，2026）与学习型 VLA 策略（Kim 等，2024；Intelligence 等，2025）传统上被视为两种不同的范式，RoboArchitect 在实证上将二者统一起来（第 4.2 节）。 与权重更新不同，控制架构的每次修订都是完全可解释的：它以直观的控制逻辑针对特定的失败模式（图 3 和图 6），使后续修订易于检查和在此基础上继续改进，而这种迭代式优化被证明是泛化的关键（第 4.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: We also equip the harness with persistent memory , allowing experience to accumulate across episodes. No schema or memory rules are specified; RoboArchitect is entirely free to decide what to store, in what form, and how to retrieve it. As a result, diverse forms of memories emerge from the harness optimization to record key pragmatic clues, such as effective grasp depths that inform later control decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还为该框架配备了持久记忆，使经验能够在多个回合之间不断积累。 我们没有指定任何模式或记忆规则；RoboArchitect 完全可以自主决定存储什么内容、以何种形式存储，以及如何进行检索。 因此，在框架优化的过程中涌现出了多种多样的记忆形式，用于记录关键的实用线索，例如为后续控制决策提供参考的有效抓取深度。

paragraphs.en: As RoboArchitect proves highly effective in solving tasks on one robot embodiment at a time, we further use its harness evolution to build a unified, generalizable agent that operates across different robot platforms ( Section 4.2 ). paragraphs.en: Vision-language-action policies. VLA policies are pretrained vision-language models finetuned for robot control, mapping visual observations and language instructions directly to robot actions ( Brohan et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2026 ; Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Shukor et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Fang et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) . In practice, their performance on new, out-of-distribution tasks can depend heavily on finetuning ( Zang et al., 2025 ; Park et al., 2026 ) , which requires collecting demonstrations for every new task or hardware configuration. Such finetuned manipulation skills often fail to generalize beyond initial training distributions ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) . Our held-out protocols test exactly this transfer ( Section 4.1 ), on which the evolved harnesses maintain substantially better performance ( Section 4.2 ). A complementary line of work keeps the policy frozen and adds inference-time mechanisms: retrieving demonstrations or successful action segments to condition the policy ( Park et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026a ) , or selecting among the policy’s candidate actions with a learned value function ( Xie et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026c ) . In contrast, RoboArchitect evolves complete agent interfaces from scratch that combine various mechanisms , including persistent memory, programmatic control, and policy orchestration, all custom-fit to each setup ( Sections 4.3 and 4.4 ).

paragraphs.en: Robotic agents. Code-as-policy methods ( Liang et al., 2023 ; Singh et al., 2022 ; Huang et al., 2023 ) bypass trained policies, and instead use executable programs as the primary robot control, composing perception, reasoning, and motion primitives. Recent coding agents go further, using iterative code generation to solve manipulation tasks ( Tsui et al., 2026 ; Kumar, 2026 ; Xie et al., 2026a ) . However, CaP-X ( Fu et al., 2026 ) shows that their success depends heavily on the hand-written primitives they are given. Other recent work retains trained VLAs but places them inside agent-level orchestration. VoLo ( Chen et al., 2026d ) treats the policy as an interruptible tool, guiding it alongside vision models and programmatic motions. Harness VLA ( Zhang et al., 2026e ) assigns high-level planning to an LLM agent and restricts the frozen policy to contact-level primitives. Several systems further decompose tasks into subproblems with memory or verification mechanisms ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026b ) . Hu et al. (2026) find that components in such hierarchical VLA architectures (planner, controllers, and switching logic) must be co-designed to maximize performance. These works establish that the interface around a VLA matters, but their agent architectures were specified manually in advance. RoboArchitect instead automates harness design and optimization, including the VLA/code division of labor ( Section 4.2 ) and persistent memory ( Section 4.4 ).

paragraphs.en: Automated code optimization. Coding models are increasingly used in auto-research routines that evaluate agent outputs, analyze execution traces, and iteratively refine agent implementations ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Wei et al., 2026 ; Zhou, 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026 ) . Within robotics, most LLM-driven optimization loops generate artifacts that train policy weights: reward functions (Eureka ( Ma et al., 2024 ) ), training configurations revised from execution logs (ENPIRE ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) ), or VLM-decomposed exploration data distilled into policies via finetuning (EXIMO ( Sukhija et al., 2026 ) ). These systems automate finetuning , and are thus complementary to RoboArchitect , which automates the agent built around a frozen policy . Another line of work accumulates reusable code skills: repairing and archiving control functions ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , searching over repositories of control code ( Elmaaroufi et al., 2026 ) , assembling computation graphs from skill libraries ( Chen et al., 2026b ) , collecting skills during self-directed play ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) , or distilling language corrections into a skill library for in-context learning ( Chen et al., 2026a ) . Crucially, these skill systems optimize programs that entirely replace the robot policy . In contrast, RoboArchitect develops the harness around a frozen policy, allowing the code to autonomously divide control between the policy and its own direct commands ( Section 4.2 ). Berman et al. (2026) similarly find that frontier coding models are more capable when given higher-level access to pretrained robot policies than when controlling low-level motion directly, an arrangement RoboArchitect often evolves into on its own.

paragraphs.en: RoboArchitect optimizes the harness around a frozen policy, as illustrated in Fig. 2 . It starts from a harness that passes the policy’s actions through unchanged and repeats an empirical optimization loop: the harness runs on the training episodes, a coding model observes the recorded rollouts, diagnoses the failures and refines the harness. These “training” episodes serve only to optimize the harness: no weights are updated , and the final harness is evaluated on separate held-out episodes ( Section 4.1 ). Over iterations, the harness grows into a highly performant robotic agent that, as needed, follows the policy, consults auxiliary tools, or commands the arm directly, and it can carry experience in a persistent memory. Below, we describe its key components.

sents.zh: 这些“训练”回合仅用于优化测试框架：不更新任何权重，最终的测试框架在单独留出的回合上进行评估（第 4.1 节）。

sents.en: Over iterations, the harness grows into a highly performant robotic agent that, as needed, follows the policy, consults auxiliary tools, or commands the arm directly, and it can carry experience in a persistent memory.
sents.zh: 随着迭代进行，测试框架成长为一个高性能的机器人智能体，它可以按需遵循策略、查询辅助工具或直接指挥机械臂，并且能够将经验保存在持久记忆中。

sents.en: Below, we describe its key components.
sents.zh: 下面我们描述其关键组件。

paragraphs.en: Harness interface. A robotic agent harness is a program that sits between environment observations and low-level robot execution commands. At each control step, the harness receives the current environment observation, including camera images, depth maps, gripper pose, and gripper status, along with the natural language task instruction. It outputs low-level action vectors executed by the robot controller. Initially, the harness is a simple pass-through of the bare VLA policy: it forwards observations to the frozen policy and returns the policy’s predicted actions directly. The Bare Policy columns of Table 1 are thus the standard evaluation of the policy alone.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体框架。 机器人智能体框架是一个位于环境观测与底层机器人执行指令之间的程序。 在每个控制步，框架接收当前的环境观测，包括相机图像、深度图、夹爪位姿和夹爪状态，以及自然语言任务指令。 它输出由机器人控制器执行的底层动作向量。 初始时，该框架只是裸 VLA 策略的简单透传：它将观测转发给冻结的策略，并直接返回策略预测的动作。 因此，表 1 的裸策略列即是对该策略本身的标准评估。

paragraphs.en: Auxiliary tools. Beyond the base policy, the harness can query auxiliary pretrained tools ( Section 4.1 ), including language models, vision-language models, object detectors, segmentation models, pointing models, and grasp pose generators. The harness also has access to geometric utilities that project pixel-depth pairs into 3D robot base coordinates, and generate relative trajectory primitives. Together, these tools give the harness alternatives to relying on the frozen policy alone.

paragraphs.en: Optimization loop. The optimization follows the same trial-and-error loop as a human engineer ( Section 1 ). Every evaluation logs complete trajectory traces, including per-step camera frames, the robot’s readings, and all model and tool outputs. A coding model reviews these execution traces from the current harness, diagnoses failure modes, and proposes a candidate harness revision, where it may follow the policy, invoke any of the tools, or command the arm programmatically. The automated optimization loop thus settles the balance between policy and programmatic control ( Section 4.2 ). The candidate is then re-evaluated on the same training set ( Section 4.1 ) and accepted only if its performance surpasses that of the current harness, following the empirical validation in prior work on self-improving agents ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . We thus ensure a monotonic optimization trajectory on the training set, capped at a maximum number of iterations ( Section 4.1 ). We compare iterative refinement with a single-attempt automated agent design in Section 4.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 优化循环。 该优化遵循与人类工程师相同的试错循环（第 1 节）。 每次评估都会记录完整的轨迹痕迹，包括逐步的相机帧、机器人的读数以及所有模型和工具输出。 一个编码模型会审查来自当前框架的这些执行痕迹，诊断失败模式，并提出候选的框架修订方案，其中它可以遵循策略、调用任意工具，或以编程方式指挥机械臂。 因此，自动化优化循环确定了策略与程序化控制之间的平衡（第 4.2 节）。 然后在同一训练集上重新评估该候选方案（第 4.1 节），并且只有当其性能超过当前框架时才被接受，这遵循了先前关于自我改进智能体工作的实证验证（Zhang et al., 2026b；Zhang et al., 2026a）。 因此，我们确保在训练集上实现单调的优化轨迹，并以最大迭代次数为上限（第 4.1 节）。 我们在第 4.2 节中将迭代式改进与单次尝试的自动化智能体设计进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Persistent memory. We also provide the harness with a persistent memory mechanism that carries information across episodes and tasks. Unlike fixed hand-crafted memory schemes in recent robotic agents ( Zhang et al., 2026e ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026b ; Gao et al., 2026 ) , our persistent memory structure is autonomously evolved based on accumulated rollout evidence , and fitted to each setup. paragraphs.en: (3) Unified harness across benchmarks . Under the protocols above, individual agents are evolved separately for each setup, allowing them to specialize to the challenges of specific embodiments. As an extension, we also evolve a single unified harness that works across multiple benchmarks simultaneously , spanning different robot embodiments, simulators and action layouts, with the goal of discovering shared cross-embodiment agent mechanisms and persistent memory structures. We take the benchmarks LIBERO-Pro, VLABench, SimplerEnv WidowX and SimplerEnv Google as test bed (Franka Panda, WidowX and the Google mobile manipulator). We use the following policy configurations: (1) the general X-VLA checkpoint, never tuned on any of these benchmarks and thus operating entirely out of distribution; (2) X-VLA specialists , one checkpoint finetuned per benchmark. To evolve the unified harness, we build a training pool of procedurally generated episodes with new scene arrangements, objects, instructions or tasks outside standard benchmark evaluations ( Fig. 9 , top), and evaluate on the benchmarks’ own standard episodes ( Fig. 9 , bottom).

paragraphs.en: An evolved harness turns a general policy into a specialist. Without any weight updates, RoboArchitect yields substantial gains across nearly all setups ( Table 1 ), and converts poorly performing cross-benchmark and out-of-domain policies ( Section 4.1 ) into functional specialists. Table 1 compares harness design and finetuning directly: on VLABench under both protocols and on SimplerEnv WidowX under unseen scenes, the evolved harness around the general policy outperforms the finetuned weights , carrying the frozen policy past a full weight update; it falls short only on SimplerEnv WidowX under unseen tasks. The gains transfer strongly to unseen scenes and unseen tasks : on unseen scenes , they generalize across novel scene arrangements, with the only minor exception of RLDX-1 on RoboCasa-365, which improved only on its optimization episodes ( Fig. 10 ); every setup also transfers positively to unseen tasks ( Table 1 ). This generalization reflects the structure of the revisions themselves: control routines work from measured geometry and the robot’s own sensing , not from static object names or positions written into the code ( Section 4.3 ), and memories are often indexed by measured physical dimensions ( Section 4.4 ). These results show that the domain gap traditionally closed through demonstration collection ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Intelligence et al., 2025 ) can also be closed through automated harness design.

paragraphs.en: The harness dynamically balances policy and programmatic control. In several setups, the evolved harness bypasses the frozen policy entirely on benchmarks a general policy was never trained for. For example, the general X-VLA on SimplerEnv WidowX commands a fully open gripper at every step, so the harness learns to disregard the policy entirely and evolves into a vision-based code-as-policy agent ( Fig. 6 i; details in Appendix A ). On its optimization episodes, this harness raised success from 0% to 100% ( Figs. 11 and 10 ), and achieved 87.5% on unseen scenes and 66.7% on unseen tasks. In contrast, the unified harness evolved on finetuned policies ( Section 4.2 ) keeps the VLA specialists in charge and intervenes only when they fail . As shown in Fig. 7 a, if late in an episode the gripper under the VLA policy’s control has never approached the instructed object, the harness takes over via the pointing tool, and directly commands the arm to reach and grasp it. The harness also learns to hand control back to the VLA policy if it is already closing in on the object ( Fig. 7 b). Most evolved harnesses settle between these two ends: the policy retains the motion it executes well, while the code takes over the decisions the policy gets wrong , such as lifting a jammed arm clear before re-querying the policy ( Fig. 3 a), or carrying the gripper to the named object before the policy grasps it ( Fig. 3 d). Crucially, we never instructed the coding model how to divide control; each harness arrived at its structure from rollout evidence alone.
paragraphs.zh: 该框架动态地平衡策略与程序化控制。 在若干设置中，演化出的框架在通用策略从未训练过的基准上完全绕过冻结策略。 例如，通用模型 X-VLA 在 SimplerEnv WidowX 上每一步都命令夹爪完全张开，因此框架学会完全无视该策略，并演化成一个基于视觉的 code-as-policy 智能体（图 6 i；详见附录 A）。 在其优化回合上，该框架将成功率从 0% 提升到 100%（图 11 和图 10），并在未见场景上达到 87.5%，在未见任务上达到 66.7%。 相比之下，在微调策略上演化出的统一框架（4.2 节）则让 VLA 专家策略保持主导，仅在其失败时进行干预。 如图 7 a 所示，若在一个回合的后期，VLA 策略控制下的夹爪始终未曾接近被指示的物体，框架便通过指向工具接管，并直接命令机械臂去抓取该物体。 该框架还学会在 VLA 策略已接近物体时把控制权交还给 VLA 策略（图 7 b）。 大多数演化出的框架处于这两个极端之间：策略保留其执行良好的动作，而代码接管策略判断错误的决策，例如在重新查询策略之前先把卡住的机械臂抬起（图 3 a），或在策略抓取之前先把夹爪移动到指定物体处（图 3 d）。 关键在于，我们从未指示编码模型如何划分控制权；每个框架都仅凭回合（rollout）证据得出其自身结构。

sents.en: For example, the general X-VLA on SimplerEnv WidowX commands a fully open gripper at every step, so the harness learns to disregard the policy entirely and evolves into a vision-based code-as-policy agent ( Fig. 6 i; details in Appendix A ).
sents.zh: 例如，通用模型 X-VLA 在 SimplerEnv WidowX 上每一步都命令夹爪完全张开，因此框架学会完全无视该策略，并演化成一个基于视觉的 code-as-policy 智能体（图 6 i；详见附录 A）。

sents.en: On its optimization episodes, this harness raised success from 0% to 100% ( Figs. 11 and 10 ), and achieved 87.5% on unseen scenes and 66.7% on unseen tasks.
sents.zh: 在其优化回合上，该框架将成功率从 0% 提升到 100%（图 11 和图 10），并在未见场景上达到 87.5%，在未见任务上达到 66.7%。

sents.en: In contrast, the unified harness evolved on finetuned policies ( Section 4.2 ) keeps the VLA specialists in charge and intervenes only when they fail .
sents.zh: 相比之下，在微调策略上演化出的统一框架（4.2 节）则让 VLA 专家策略保持主导，仅在其失败时进行干预。

sents.en: As shown in Fig. 7 a, if late in an episode the gripper under the VLA policy’s control has never approached the instructed object, the harness takes over via the pointing tool, and directly commands the arm to reach and grasp it.
sents.zh: 如图 7 a 所示，若在一个回合的后期，VLA 策略控制下的夹爪始终未曾接近被指示的物体，框架便通过指向工具接管，并直接命令机械臂去抓取该物体。

sents.en: The harness also learns to hand control back to the VLA policy if it is already closing in on the object ( Fig. 7 b).
sents.zh: 该框架还学会在 VLA 策略已接近物体时把控制权交还给 VLA 策略（图 7 b）。

sents.en: Most evolved harnesses settle between these two ends: the policy retains the motion it executes well, while the code takes over the decisions the policy gets wrong , such as lifting a jammed arm clear before re-querying the policy ( Fig. 3 a), or carrying the gripper to the named object before the policy grasps it ( Fig. 3 d).
sents.zh: 大多数演化出的框架处于这两个极端之间：策略保留其执行良好的动作，而代码接管策略判断错误的决策，例如在重新查询策略之前先把卡住的机械臂抬起（图 3 a），或在策略抓取之前先把夹爪移动到指定物体处（图 3 d）。

sents.en: Crucially, we never instructed the coding model how to divide control; each harness arrived at its structure from rollout evidence alone.
sents.zh: 关键在于，我们从未指示编码模型如何划分控制权；每个框架都仅凭回合（rollout）证据得出其自身结构。

paragraphs.en: A unified harness works across robots. We next test whether a single harness can generalize across embodiments ( Section 4.1 ; results in Table 2 , full evolution trajectories in Fig. 12 ). The general X-VLA model scores near zero across all benchmarks, as it is entirely out of distribution ( Table 2 ). The harness then evolves into a pure code-as-policy agent, replacing the general VLA entirely (as in Section 4.2 ). It raises every benchmark from (near) zero, reaching 41.6% on the training pool and 28.8% on held-out evaluation. This unified harness reads everything that differs between robots at runtime from the action specification and proprioception, never hardcoding embodiment-specific constants ( Sections 4.3 and 4.4 ). It thus operates across embodiments without domain-specific finetuning . Using finetuned specialists as base policies, the unified harness yields smaller gains. These policies already perform well (58.0% training, 45.9% held-out), and so our auto-evolved harness correctly preserves their native competence . As such, the unified harness strikes the same balance as individual setups ( Section 4.2 ): it evolves into a pure code-as-policy agent when wrapping the general VLA, but correctly preserves native competence when wrapping finetuned specialists.

paragraphs.en: Iterative refinement further improves the automatically designed harness. A coding model can already design an agent from scratch in one attempt. But the agent itself generates new evidence through its own execution, and the same optimization process of RoboArchitect can use that evidence to refine it further. The harness after the first iteration ( One-Shot in Tables 1 and 2 ) represents a one-shot agent design : the coding model sees the bare VLA policy’s rollout failures (iteration 0) and produces an agent in a single attempt (iteration 1). Subsequent iterations observe the behavior of this agent and refine its control logic based on newly exposed failure modes ( Section 3 ), up to iteration 5 ( Iterative in Tables 1 and 2 ). Figs. 10 , 11 and 12 illustrate these optimization trajectories, showing steady, mostly monotonic progression over iterations. As shown in Table 1 , the iteratively evolved harness outperforms the one-shot design on the training set in every setup ( Figs. 10 and 11 ) and on held-out sets, except RLDX-1 on RoboCasa-365 under unseen scenes. For example, the code-as-policy agent on VLABench is built in its first attempt, and only its own rollouts reveal subtler failures, which later revisions repair ( Fig. 6 g,h; details in Appendix A ). Iterative refinement also improves generalization : while some one-shot designs fall below the bare VLA policy on unseen scenes or tasks, the iteratively evolved harness surpasses it on nearly every held-out set ( Table 1 ). The improvement is not limited to adding new tools: later revisions also refine the division of control between the policy and programmatic logic, as discussed in Section 4.2 . These results show that the harness is not merely automatically designed, but can iteratively self-improve by inspecting the execution traces of its own previous designs.

paragraphs.en: The evolved harnesses address concrete failure modes with targeted control routines. Figs. 3 and 6 show representative revisions across benchmarks. The harnesses learn to detect and clear arm jams that the policy cannot recover from ( Fig. 3 a), and to synthesize missing motion primitives , such as a side approach under a shelf board or a handle pull on a cabinet ( Fig. 3 b, Fig. 5 e). On RoboCasa-365, they rescale contact forces when the policy pushes a door too gently ( Fig. 3 c), and tether the mobile base to active workspaces when it drifts away ( Fig. 5 f). Other routines make perception more reliable: the harness redirects the arm to the target object when a policy overfit to its training scenes reaches for a memorized location ( Fig. 3 d), and adapts to perception limitations by working down ranked candidates and checking for firm grasps from depth ( Fig. 6 g,h). The unified harness also adapts to each robot’s setup , such as its speed: it ends each move when the arm arrives, not on a fixed time budget ( Fig. 7 c), which contributed to raising the training-pool success rate on the slower Google robot from 11.0% to 30.2%. Appendix A details each routine.
paragraphs.zh: 进化出的外挂例程通过有针对性的控制例程来解决具体的失败模式。 图3和图6展示了各基准测试中具有代表性的修改。 外挂例程学会检测并清除策略自身无法恢复的机械臂卡堵（图3a），并合成缺失的运动基元，例如在搁板下方从侧面接近或拉动柜门把手（图3b、图5e）。 在RoboCasa-365上，当策略推门力度过轻时，它们会重新调整接触力（图3c）；当移动底座漂移离开时，它们会将其拴回活动工作区（图5f）。 其他例程使感知更加可靠：当过拟合于训练场景的策略伸向记忆中的位置时，外挂例程会将机械臂重定向到目标物体（图3d），并通过依次尝试排序后的候选物体、利用深度图像检查是否抓牢，来适应感知的局限（图6g,h）。 统一的外挂例程还会适应每个机器人的具体配置，例如其速度：它在机械臂到位时结束每次移动，而不是按固定的时间预算（图7c），这将较慢的Google机器人训练池的成功率从11.0%提升到了30.2%。 附录A详细介绍了每个例程。

Table 3 lists examples of memory entries and how often each held-out episode reads the memory. Rather than following any predefined memory schema, RoboArchitect discovers diverse forms of memories that capture reusable execution experience, task and environment context, and embodiment-specific calibration .

paragraphs.en: Memories learn from the harness’s own grasps : one records the grasp heights that lifted objects, relative to each object’s measured height, and consults them on new objects ( Fig. 4 a); another remembers the grip style ( pinch or spread ) that held each object ( Fig. 4 b). Indexed by measured physical properties or object identity, this experience carries over to novel objects and new tasks. Memories also track implicit task and environment clues , such as which instructions need holding objects ( Fig. 4 c) and the 150-step scene-reset period of RoboCerebra. The unified harness calibrates itself to each robot , recording which way the robot’s fingers close to orient later grasps ( Fig. 4 d). Appendix A details each type of memory .

paragraphs.en: Importantly, these memories are data structures within the designed robot agent , not the coding model’s own context: they accumulate information during the agent’s rollouts and persist across episodes at execution time. paragraphs.en: We introduced RoboArchitect to automate the design and optimization of agent harnesses around frozen robot policies. Across diverse benchmarks and frozen policies, the evolved harnesses substantially improve performance on held-out scenes and tasks. Even when the policy is untuned for the target environment, RoboArchitect can adapt it to a specialist in out-of-domain settings, and can even outperform its finetuned version. Crucially, the harness continues to self-improve beyond its initial design, using the behavior of previous versions as new evidence for subsequent refinements. Emergent from harness optimization, we observe intuitive control routines that resolve specific failure modes, and persistent memories that carry experience across episodes to inform later decisions. RoboArchitect can also evolve a unified harness that works across multiple embodiments, adapting itself to each robot. Together, these results suggest that substantial headroom in robot manipulation resides in the agent harness, and that this headroom can be unlocked by automatically evolving the harness for novel setups.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 RoboArchitect，用于自动化设计和优化围绕冻结机器人策略构建的智能体框架。 在多样化的基准测试和冻结策略上，演化出的框架在保留场景和任务上显著提升了性能。 即使策略未针对目标环境进行调优，RoboArchitect 也能将其适配成域外设置中的专家，甚至可以超越其微调后的版本。 至关重要的是，该框架能在初始设计之后持续自我改进，将先前版本的行为作为新证据用于后续的优化。 从框架优化中涌现出的，是我们观察到的直观控制例程，它们能解决特定的失败模式；还有持久记忆，它们能跨回合携带经验，为后续决策提供参考。 RoboArchitect 还能演化出在多种本体上通用的统一框架，并针对每个机器人进行自我适配。 综上所述，这些结果表明机器人操作中还有巨大的提升空间蕴藏于智能体框架之中，而通过为新的设置自动演化框架即可释放这些空间。

paragraphs.en: Detecting and clearing arm jams. When the arm is jammed against an object, the bare policy may continue issuing similar commands because its visual observations remain nearly unchanged during a jam, so it tips objects over and cannot recover. The evolved harness learns to monitor discrepancies between commanded and actual gripper movements; when disagreement persists, it lifts the arm clear before re-querying the policy ( Fig. 3 a).
paragraphs.zh: 检测并清除机械臂卡阻。 当机械臂被物体卡住时，裸策略可能继续发出类似的指令，因为卡阻期间其视觉观测几乎不变，导致它将物体碰倒且无法恢复。 进化出的框架学会监测指令夹爪运动与实际夹爪运动之间的差异；当不一致持续存在时，它会先将机械臂抬升到避开物体的位置，再重新查询策略（图 3 a）。

paragraphs.en: Synthesizing missing motion primitives. Some tasks require motion primitives absent from the base policy or the earlier harness, such as approaching an object from the side rather than from above. For retrieving a book from the shelf on VLABench, the earlier harness defaults to top-down motion and collides with the overhead board. The evolved harness detects overhead obstructions via depth maps and computes horizontal approach vectors to reach beneath them ( Fig. 3 b). The same pattern appears elsewhere: on RoboCerebra, the harness adds a wrist-rotation primitive for pouring with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , while for cabinet opening with SmolVLA, it locates the cabinet with the pointing model, finds its handles in the depth image, then aligns and pulls ( Fig. 5 e).

paragraphs.en: Adapting to perception limitations. When the VLA policy is unusable, the harness evolves into a pure code-as-policy agent ( Section 4.2 ). Crucially, such agents continue to refine their own perception and control mechanisms across iterations ( Section 4.2 ). On VLABench, the vision tools could not reliably distinguish mahjong tile faces. Rather than relying on a single vision prediction, the harness maintains a ranked candidate list, sequentially interacting with candidate tiles until the task completes ( Fig. 6 g). Vision-based grasp verification could also be unreliable, causing the agent to prematurely put down objects it was holding. The harness thus replaces visual grasp checks with a depth check under the fingertips , verifying grasps by the presence of a surface just below the fingers ( Fig. 6 h).

paragraphs.en: Per-robot control-rate independence. The unified harness ( Section 4.2 ) evolves mechanisms that adapt control to each robot across platforms (see Fig. 7 ). Each motion phase used to end on a fixed time budget, which on a slower platform ( e.g., the 3 Hz Google robot, Fig. 7 c) expires while the arm is still in transit. The evolved harness ends a move only when the arm arrives or stops making progress, measured by the distance between the arm’s position and its target rather than by elapsed time, and reaches handles on vertical surfaces from the front along the measured surface normal. The revision that introduced these changes raised the agent’s performance on the Google robot from 11.0% to 30.2% on the training pool.
paragraphs.zh: 每台机器人的控制频率相互独立。 统一的框架（第 4.2 节）演化出跨平台为每台机器人自适应调整控制的机制（见图 7）。 过去每个运动阶段都在固定的时间预算内结束，而在较慢的平台上（例如 3 Hz 的 Google 机器人，图 7c），时间预算会在机械臂仍在移动时耗尽。 演化出的框架仅在机械臂到达目标或停止取得进展时才结束一次移动，衡量依据是机械臂位置与其目标之间的距离而非已过时间，并且从正面沿测得的表面法线抓取垂直表面上的把手。 引入这些更改的修订将智能体在 Google 机器人上训练池中的表现从 11.0% 提升到 30.2%。

paragraphs.en: Learning execution parameters from experience. The harnesses store empirical execution statistics that inform later control decisions. On SimplerEnv WidowX, the harness records the grasp heights that have successfully lifted an object, as a function of measured object height, so that effective grasp parameters transfer to novel objects ( Fig. 4 a). On LIBERO-Pro-10, the MolmoAct-2 harness instead averages the depth of successful grasps below the object top, as a share of the object’s height, and uses this statistic to parameterize fallback grasps. The OpenVLA-7B harness similarly records the grip style, pinch or spread , that succeeds for each object, so future grasps select the proven pose when the object’s shape allows both ( Fig. 4 b). Crucially, across these designs, memory is indexed by actual, measured physical properties or object identity rather than specific task names, so experience generalizes to novel objects across different tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 从经验中学习执行参数。 这些框架会存储经验性的执行统计数据，用于指导后续的控制决策。 在 SimplerEnv WidowX 上，框架会记录成功举起物体时所处的抓取高度，并将其作为测量物体高度的函数，从而使有效的抓取参数能够迁移到新物体上（图 4 a）。 在 LIBERO-Pro-10 上，MolmoAct-2 框架则改为将成功抓取时低于物体顶部的深度取平均，以其占物体高度的比例表示，并利用这一统计量来参数化回退抓取。 OpenVLA-7B 框架同样会记录每种物体成功时使用的抓握方式——捏取或张开，因此当物体的形状允许两种方式时，未来的抓取就会选择已被验证有效的姿态（图 4 b）。 至关重要的是，在这些设计中，记忆都以实际测量到的物理属性或物体本身为索引，而非特定的任务名称，因此经验能够跨任务泛化到新物体上。

paragraphs.en: Tracking implicit task and environment clues. Persistent memory also captures recurring clues in the task instruction and environment. On RoboCasa-365, the harness associates instruction verbs with the need to hold (“pick up”) an object: once sufficient evidence accumulates for a “picking” task, it enables an empty-grasp recovery routine that retries when fingers close on nothing, while leaving the routine disabled for “pressing” tasks where a closed empty gripper is intentional ( Fig. 4 c). On RoboCerebra, the harness discovers and stores the environment’s 150-step scene-reset period, allowing later episodes to anticipate resets and take over a placement early enough to finish it before the reset. Memories are also used to cache inference outputs, such as VLM/LLM parses of multi-step instructions, so that repeated executions avoid redundant computation.

sents.en: Memories are also used to cache inference outputs, such as VLM/LLM parses of multi-step instructions, so that repeated executions avoid redundant computation.
sents.zh: 记忆还被用于缓存推理输出，例如对多步指令的 VLM/LLM 解析结果，从而避免重复执行时产生冗余计算。

paragraphs.en: Persistent self-calibration across embodiments. In the unified harness ( Section 4.2 ), persistent memory additionally stores embodiment-specific calibration. Because finger motion differs across robots, the harness opens and closes the empty gripper, observes the resulting motion in the depth image, and stores the kinematic mapping in memory . This calibration guides grasp orientation across different embodiments ( e.g., on the Franka arm and on the Google robot) ( Fig. 4 d). The same routine records the resting finger configuration, providing a reference for detecting empty grasps on robots reporting finger positions.
paragraphs.zh: 跨本体形态的持续自校准。 在统一框架（第4.2节）中，持久记忆还额外存储特定本体形态的校准信息。 由于不同机器人的手指运动各不相同，该框架会开合空载夹爪，观察深度图像中由此产生的运动，并将运动学映射存储到记忆中。 该校准可指导不同本体形态下的抓取朝向（例如在Franka机械臂和Google机器人上）（图4d）。 同样的流程还会记录手指的静止构型，为在报告手指位置的机器人上检测空抓取提供参考。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks. LIBERO-Pro-10 evaluates long-horizon task sequences from LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) with initial object locations swapped while preserving original natural language instructions. These spatial swaps follow the LIBERO-Pro benchmark protocol ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) designed to distinguish genuine manipulation skill from spatial memorization via overfitting on LIBERO. RoboCerebra ( Han et al., 2025 ) tests on a sequence of short manipulation tasks with scene resets every 150 control steps, challenging the ability to handle sudden environment changes. VLABench ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) requires identifying specific target items among visually similar distractors with a focus on visual grounding. RoboCasa-365 ( Nasiriany et al., 2024 ; Nasiriany et al., 2026 ) places a mobile manipulator in varied kitchen environments, requiring coordinated mobile navigation and arm control. SimplerEnv WidowX ( Li et al., 2024 ) deploys a WidowX manipulator within photorealistic scenes, testing cross-embodiment transfer under visual domain shift. SimplerEnv Google ( Li et al., 2024 ) deploys the Google mobile manipulator under the same visual domain shift as SimplerEnv WidowX, and is included in the test bed of the unified harness ( Section 4.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试。 LIBERO-Pro-10 评估来自 LIBERO（Liu et al., 2023）的长时程任务序列，其初始物体位置被交换，同时保留原始自然语言指令。 这些空间位置交换遵循 LIBERO-Pro 基准协议（Zhou et al., 2025），该协议旨在通过在 LIBERO 上过拟合所导致的空间记忆来区分真正的操作技能。 RoboCerebra（Han et al., 2025）在一系列短操作任务上进行测试，每 150 个控制步重置一次场景，考验应对环境突变的能力。 VLABench（Zhang et al., 2025）要求在视觉上相似的干扰物中识别特定目标物品，重点在于视觉定位。 RoboCasa-365（Nasiriany et al., 2024; Nasiriany et al., 2026）将移动操作机器人置于多样化的厨房环境中，要求协调的移动导航与机械臂控制。 SimplerEnv WidowX（Li et al., 2024）在照片级真实感场景中部署 WidowX 操作臂，测试视觉域偏移下的跨本体迁移。 SimplerEnv Google（Li et al., 2024）在与 SimplerEnv WidowX 相同的视觉域偏移下部署 Google 移动操作机器人，并被纳入统一评测框架的测试平台（第 4.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: Cost of automated harness optimization. A complete evolution of 5 iterations ( Section 4.1 ) takes under 6 hours of coding-model time and stays under $150 on average, with no demonstrations collected and no model weights updated. Through RoboArchitect , the engineering loop that is slow by hand ( Section 1 ) becomes an inexpensive routine easily repeatable for every new robot setup.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化测试框架优化的成本。 一次包含 5 轮迭代的完整演化（第 4.1 节）所需的编码模型时间不超过 6 小时，平均花费不超过 150 美元，且无需收集任何演示，也不更新任何模型权重。 通过 RoboArchitect，人工操作时缓慢的工程循环（第 1 节）变成了一种低成本的常规流程，可以方便地针对每个新机器人系统重复执行。
